ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The rectangular wire frame abcd starts moving from rest. If the frame translates toward ___, and side ad has not yet entered the magnetic field, an induced current will be produced in the frame.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the dashed rectangular region in the figure represents the magnetic-field region, inside which multiple “×” are drawn, indicating that the magnetic-field direction is perpendicular to the paper inward, and it is labeled B. The rectangular wire frame abcd straddles near the boundary of the magnetic field; the left side ad is on the left side of the dashed magnetic-field region and has not yet entered the magnetic field; the right side bc is already located inside the magnetic-field region, and part of the area of the frame is in the magnetic field. Then reason: the question stem requires the frame to undergo translational motion, and when side ad has not yet entered the magnetic field, an induced current is produced in the frame. The condition for producing induced current is that the magnetic flux through the closed wire frame changes. If the frame translates to the right, before side ad enters the magnetic field, the area of the frame entering the magnetic field will continue to increase; the magnetic-field direction and strength do not change, but the effective area penetrated by the magnetic field increases, so the magnetic flux changes with time, and therefore an induced current will be produced. Thus the blank should be filled with “right”.
